verdict.rationale: Productboard's own materials say it automatically detects insights in feedback and links them to feature ideas. They also say it surfaces critical feedback trends and new opportunities with citations, and that a built-in agent handles synthesis. Together these cover the core of the story. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of decluttering (deduplicating, clustering or summarizing raw feedback noise), in-depth documentation of how impact is ranked, and independent or hands-on corroboration beyond marketing-page claims.
